notes.checksum: The SHA-256 of the archive file, which is exactly what `swift package compute-checksum` reports and what SwiftPM enforces before unpacking a URL binary target. Verified equal on 2026-07-30.
notes.contentDigest: A digest of paths, modes, and file bytes, independent of how the tree is archived. The archive's own checksum also depends on zlib, so this is the value a rebuild can honestly re-derive on another machine.
notes.tag: Content-addressed rather than keyed to a ghosttea release. `.binaryTarget(url:checksum:)` needs a checksum already valid at the commit SwiftPM resolves, but release assets are built after their release commit — so a per-release artifact could never carry a valid checksum at its own tag.
notes.published: The archive is attached to its release and resolves: verified on 2026-07-30 by downloading this URL and confirming the archive hashes to the recorded checksum, then by a clean `swift package resolve` against it, which SwiftPM checksum-verified and unpacked, followed by a successful `swift build --target GhostteaCore`. The release gate fails closed while this is false. These bytes are never replaced in place — the Apple build is not byte-reproducible across toolchains, and every consumer's SwiftPM checksum is pinned to them, so a changed artifact takes a new content digest and a new tag.
notes.supersedes: ghosttea-apple-native-3883818b918d, which carried the pre-0.6.2 key encoder and cursor reporting. The shim compiles into every slice, so the Apple plane needed rebuilt bytes rather than only a version bump — this digest is what makes that visible.
